scope: Reject duplicate case-folded ACAD_GROUP root entries before DXF publication.

implementation.behavior: The adapter preflight now validates an existing ACAD_GROUP NOD edge as a unique key to exactly one DICTIONARY owned by the owner-zero NOD, and rejects any additional NOD key aliasing that dictionary. Authored GROUPs without a source NOD entry remain eligible for writer-generated root creation. The existing selector adds duplicate-root and same-target alias negatives for both ASCII and Binary, checks byte-for-byte destination preservation, retries corrected input through the same adapter, and verifies the GROUP/member identity on strict readback.
